title: Impact on households: distributional analysis to accompany Budget 2026
method: Read from the vector chart geometry in the PDF (pdftocairo SVG): bar segment edges and Overall markers converted to values by interpolating between the y-axis ticks. Each Overall marker matches the sum of its segments to within 0.01 percentage points (1.A, 1.C), £0.3 (1.B), £5 (1.D) and 0.2 points (1.E).
